subtopics.title: The Effect of a — Stretch, Squash and Flip

questions.question: For y = ax², a NEGATIVE value of a means the parabola:
options: Opens downward, with a maximum turning point
Opens upward, with a minimum turning point

questions.question: Compared with y = x², the graph of y = ½x² is:
options: Wider, because every y-value is halved so the curve climbs more slowly

questions.question: In y = ax² + q, the parameter q:
options: Shifts the whole graph vertically by q units, changing nothing else
Shifts the graph left or right by q units
Reflects the graph in the y-axis

questions.question: Solving 0 = x² − 9 gives:
options: x = 3 or x = −3 — the plus-or-minus is compulsory

questions.question: Why does y = x² + 4 have NO x-intercepts?
options: Because x² = −4 has no real solution, and the upward-opening curve has its lowest point 4 units above the axis

options: Describing a = ½ as making the graph 'smaller' rather than WIDER

subtopics.title: The Shape of a Thrown Ball

questions.question: The path of a kicked soccer ball is a parabola because:
options: It climbs, turns once, and falls in a path that mirrors the climb
It travels in a straight line
It speeds up all the way

questions.question: Squaring 3 and squaring −3 both give 9. On the graph this shows up as:
options: A left half that mirrors the right half across a vertical line

subtopics.title: Turning the Bowl Over and Lifting It

questions.question: In the bowl picture, the SIGN of the number multiplying the squared part decides:
options: Whether the bowl is a soup bowl the right way up or a fly cover upside down
Where the bowl crosses the vertical axis

questions.question: A number bigger than one in front of the squared part makes the bowl:
options: Wide and flat, like a serving dish
Tall and narrow, like a vase

questions.question: The number added on its own at the end gives you two things at once:
options: Where the curve crosses the vertical axis, and the height of the turning point

questions.question: An upright bowl LIFTED above the line has how many crossings of that line?
options: None — like a soup bowl on a high shelf, it never reaches the floor

subtopics.title: Four Moves to a Sketch — and the Traps

questions.question: The four sketching moves, in order, are:
options: Which way up; where the turning point is; where it crosses the flat axis; one extra point plus the mirror
Extra point; crossings; turning point; direction

questions.question: For y = 2x² − 8, the extra point at x = 3 is:

options: It throws away the second crossing, x = −2, and wrecks the symmetry of the sketch

questions.question: The working gives 'x² = −4'. The correct response is:
options: State that there are no x-intercepts, because nothing real squares to a negative
